policy.return_details_heading: Return costs and exceptions — the short version
policy.return_postage: For a change-of-mind return, you pay the return postage.
policy.damaged_costs: If an item is verified as damaged, defective, incomplete or incorrect, Loemies covers the appropriate return or replacement cost.
policy.hygiene_exception: Only personalised items, gift cards and sealed hygiene-sensitive goods after the seal is broken are excluded; standard unopened toys are returnable when eligible.

about.title: Fewer, better choices for everyday play
about.intro: Loemies is operated from Bonheiden, Belgium by Systemize BV. We help families find thoughtful toys without wading through endless options, with useful details, age-aware discovery and direct support when you need it.
about.choice_text: We keep discovery manageable and organize toys by the way families actually shop: age, play style and purpose.
about.details_text: Maker-supplied age guidance, materials, dimensions and care information belong where the buying decision happens.
about.support_text: Questions about a product, delivery or a return go to the Loemies team, with contact details kept easy to find.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: The practical answers that should be clear before you place an order.
faq.shipping_answer: Tracked shipping is €6.99. Orders of €50 or more ship free automatically. The delivery estimate is shown before payment.
faq.returns_question: How long do I have to request a return?
faq.returns_answer: You have {{ days }} days to tell us you want to return an order. Check the refund policy for eligibility, instructions and any return costs before sending anything back.
faq.age_question: How do I choose the right age?
faq.age_answer: Use the age guidance on product cards and product pages. It follows the maker’s recommendation; check the full product details for the specific child and always follow the supplied safety instructions.
faq.sold_out_question: What can I do when a product is sold out?
faq.sold_out_answer: Open the product page and send an availability enquiry. Our team will reply with an update; this does not subscribe you to marketing.
faq.help_question: Can I ask a question before ordering?
faq.help_answer: Yes. Send the product name and your question through the contact page so we can give you a specific answer.
faq.return_cost_answer: For a change-of-mind return, you pay the return postage. If an item is verified as damaged, defective or incorrect, Loemies covers the appropriate return or replacement cost.
faq.damaged_question: What if my order arrives damaged, incomplete or incorrect?
faq.damaged_answer: Contact us as soon as possible with your order number and clear photos. We will check the issue and arrange the appropriate replacement, refund or return instructions.
faq.split_question: Can one order arrive in more than one parcel?
faq.split_answer: Yes. Products from different brands or EU warehouses can ship separately. Each dispatched parcel receives its own tracking update, with no extra shipping fee beyond the amount shown at checkout.
